description: This file defines a React component named FavoriteToggle that allows users to toggle a favorite state on a post identified by postId. It manages local state for favorites, loading status, and toast messages, and interacts with a backend mutation function toggleFavoriteOptimistic to persist changes. The component conditionally renders UI elements including a button with visual indicators and a count of favorites.

methods.name: FavoriteToggle
methods.description: React functional component supporting favorite toggling for a post, managing local state, performing optimistic updates, and triggering UI feedback.
